lines.text: This is one grain of rice. Every second, it doubles.
How long until it swallows the Sun?
Ten seconds. About a thousand grains. Barely a handful.
Fourteen seconds. Sixteen thousand. A full bowl.
Twenty-three seconds. Eight million grains. Enough to fill a bathtub.
Thirty-four seconds. Seventeen billion. A whole house, packed to the roof.
Forty-seven seconds. The Great Pyramid of Giza, buried.
Fifty-five seconds. More rice than the whole world harvests in a year.
Ninety-five seconds. The entire planet Earth.
One hundred sixteen seconds. The Sun.
And in under five minutes, it fills the observable universe.
That's the power of doubling. Follow for more.
